Alex —

Quick response with a structured framework attached (northbridge_term_options.xlsx). Two pathways as requested:

1) Conservative Pathway (Compliance-first) — 12-month commit.
  - Recurring: audit-log retention tier (90 days standard) + KMS managed seats (per-seat for on-prem HSM entitlement) + residency surcharge (region lock). Estimated blended uplift: ~18–24% on hosted unit price.
  - One-time: onboarding & evidence package (SOC/SIEM ingest proofing) including attestation setup and HSM key escrow set-up.
  - Pros: minimal risk, full evidence handoff.

2) Accelerated Pathway (Pilot-friendly) — 6-month commit with staged activation.
  - Recurring: lower initial uplift (10–12%) with audit-log sampling and managed KMS (no HSM seats unless escalated).
  - One-time: reduced evidence fee, conditional credits for conversion to Conservative.
  - Pros: lower up-front, faster time-to-value.

Pilot credits: we can apply a 30% credit to the one-time evidence/onboarding fee for a 3-month pilot and commit to a review milestone. Conversion from Accelerated -> Conservative triggers remaining onboarding balance pro-rated.

Open items we want to confirm with you: expected QPS and ingestion footprint for audit logs (daily GB), whether you require a FIPS-level HSM now or later, and whether residency needs extend to disaster-recovery region. If you can provide those, we’ll firm numbers.

I’m looping in Stephanie to comment on commercial terms and Laura on implementation timeline. Sending the matrix in the attached workbook.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Safeguard packaging — commercial notes

Alex —

Adding a few commercial clarifications so your procurement model can map to P&L:

- Billing cadence: recurring charges billed monthly; evidence/onboarding is invoiced upfront but eligible for the pilot credit if you sign the pilot SOW.
- Discounting: we can offer a volume tier discount at commit thresholds (6 months: 5% uplift reduction; 12 months: 10% reduction on the security add-on lines).
- HSM treatment: two options — seat-based (annual subscription per HSM instance) or throughput-based (per-crypto-op). Seat-based provides predictable capex-like cost; throughput is variable. We recommend seat-based for hospital-grade SLAs.
- Audit-log retention: we include a 90-day baseline. Longer retention tiers add a storage component (sized to GB/mo).
- Evidence delivery: we propose milestone-based delivery (design review, attestation handoff, SOC evidence bundle) with credits tied to completion if requested.

I’ll prepare a sample term sheet page showing how the math flows (example rows: base usage, add-on uplift, onboarding fee, pilot credit, amortization over commit term).

Thanks — happy to jump on quick call tomorrow morning to finalize scope.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Commercial Operations
